en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large ceremonial parade along a city street lined with multi‑story European-style buildings and dense crowds on both sides. A mounted figure in elaborate historical armor rides at the center toward a large temporary triumphal arch decorated with garlands and inscriptions. Many spectators wear early 20th‑century clothing and military uniforms, some watching from balconies. Cyrillic text is printed along the bottom border of the image.
